This is a short test of the on-device voice conversation lab. The microphone is active while this sentence is spoken. The voice activity detector runs first, and it should stop playback as soon as a person begins speaking. Transcription and conversation handling happen only after that fast interruption signal. This demo is intentionally longer than a short sentence so there is time to test an interruption. The local speech tools run on the phone, and this sample does not call a network service.
